description: Founded in Casablanca, Evo High-Tech builds sovereign, 100% offline-first AI architectures (Edge Computing) for critical water optimization and climate-resilient agriculture. Our prototype integrates solar systems, IoT telemetry, and predictive modeling with zero cloud dependency. We are looking for driven builders in Rust, IoT, agronomy, and embedded systems to scale AERO-CROP 360 for global impact
summary: AERO-CROP 360 is an autonomous, air-gapped Edge AI system engineered for precision agriculture in arid regions like Casablanca (MGRS 29R QF). Operating via a high-performance Pure-Rust (Tokio / Axum) engine, it transforms raw NASA Earth observation data into deterministic field protocols without requiring continuous internet access. The platform features dual-mode NASA telemetry ingestion, cryptographic SHA-256 data auditing, a real-time hardware bridge over COM3 for automated irrigation control, thermal anomaly mitigation (>36.0°C), and a tri-lingual tactical cockpit (EN, FR, Darija). By bridging orbital space data with local hardware actuation, AERO-CROP 360 secures crop yields, conserves water resources, and empowers off-grid farming communities with space-grade digital sovereignty
details:
### Overview & Problem Solved

AERO-CROP 360 transforms raw orbital Earth observation data into deterministic, actionable field protocols without requiring continuous internet access. Built as a single-binary Pure-Rust edge engine (Tokio / Axum), it operates via an auto-waking daemon architecture: any CLI audit, sandbox query, or local sensor trigger automatically spawns the background REST API and interactive Web Cockpit on port 8080.

### How It Works (Core Pipeline)

1. Dual-Mode NASA Telemetry Ingestion: Queries live NASA POWER agroclimatology APIs when online and caches localized MGRS grid cells into a local JSON bank sealed with SHA-256 cryptographic hashes for offline auditability.

2. Predictive Copilot & Soil Moisture Modeling: Models daily evapotranspiration (ET0) and spectral water-stress indices to forecast root-zone soil moisture and drought probability, recommending optimal drip-irrigation adjustments.

3. Calibrated Climate Shock & Hazard Engine: Continuously evaluates surface temperature and moisture thresholds. Thermal anomalies exceeding 36.0°C trigger immediate daytime irrigation halts and geotextile shading protocols via hardware actuators on COM3.

4. Tri-Lingual Accessibility & Automated Reporting: Delivers real-time diagnostics in English, French, and Moroccan Darija, while generating standardized Markdown submission dossiers.

### Benefits & Expected Impact

- Water Conservation & Yield Protection: Reduces agricultural water waste by up to 30% through predictive deficit irrigation and prevents crop loss during sudden heatwaves.

- Digital Sovereignty & Rural Inclusion: Empowers off-grid farms in arid regions with space-grade intelligence without recurring cloud subscriptions.

### Tools, Languages & Architecture

- Core Backend & Edge Daemon: Rust (2021 Edition), Tokio async runtime, Axum web server, Serde, Chrono, SHA-2 (sha2 crate).

- Hardware Integration: serialport crate managing physical COM3 valves and GNSS sensors.

- Frontend & Visualization: HTML5, Vanilla JavaScript, interactive planetary telemetry cockpit.

- Version Control: Git synchronized across GitHub and Codeberg.
